# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment facts generated for the eShopOnWeb application. Use these documents alongside the core assessment report and .NET upgrade assessment findings.

## Supplementary Documents

- [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) - Architecture diagrams and component relationship overview.
- [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency categories, compatibility risks, and test dependency summary.
- [Api Service Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) - API endpoints, service catalog, contracts, communication patterns, and security posture.
- [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) - Persistence configuration, entity model, repository methods, caching, and data sensitivity.
- [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime profiles, properties, secrets workflow, and runtime versions.
- [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) - Core domain workflows, service-to-domain mapping, cross-service data flows, and business rules.
